activity.notes: The National Inventors Hall of Fame records Carrier's first scientific air-conditioning installation in operation in 1902 and his disclosure of the Rational Psychrometric Formulae in 1911. ATLAS uses 1902-1911 as a bounded invention-and-systematization phase rather than his full engineering career or lifespan.
